desc_zh_game: 被鳞粉守护着，不会受到招式的追加效果影响。

desc_en: Its shell breaks if its HP becomes half or less.
desc_zh_game: HP变为一半时，壳会坏掉，变得有攻击性。

desc_en: The Pokémon is prone to wild stat changes.
desc_zh_game: 能力变化会变为平时的2倍。

desc_en: Increases the frequency of multi-strike moves.
desc_zh_game: 如果使用连续招式，总是能使出最高次数。

desc_en: Temporarily halves Attack and Speed.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内，攻击和速度减半。

desc_en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a hailstorm.
desc_zh_game: 冰雹天气时，速度会提高。

desc_en: Powers up moves if they become critical hits.
desc_zh_game: 击中要害时，威力会变得更强。

desc_en: Raises evasion in a hailstorm.
desc_zh_game: 冰雹天气时，闪避率会提高。

desc_en: The Pokémon summons a hailstorm in battle.
desc_zh_game: 出场时，会将天气变为冰雹。

desc_en: In sunshine, Sp. Atk is boosted but HP decreases.
desc_zh_game: 晴朗天气时，特攻会提高，而每回合HP会减少。

desc_en: Reduces damage from super-effective attacks.
desc_zh_game: 受到效果绝佳的攻击时，可以减弱其威力。

desc_en: Boosts Sp. Atk each time a Pokémon faints.
desc_zh_game: 宝可梦每次变为濒死状态时，特攻会提高。

desc_en: Gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.
desc_zh_game: 通过屏蔽声音，不受到声音招式的攻击。

desc_en: Its Speed stat is gradually boosted.
desc_zh_game: 每一回合速度会变快。

desc_en: Deals doubles damage to a target's replacement.
desc_zh_game: 可以对替换出场的对手以2倍的伤害进行攻击。

desc_en: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.
desc_zh_game: 使出招式的顺序必定会变为最后。

desc_en: Boosts Defense when hit by an attack.
desc_zh_game: 受到攻击时，防御会提高。

desc_en: Changes between Blade and Shield Forme with attacks.
desc_zh_game: 根据招式会变为刀剑形态或盾牌形态。

desc_en: Contact with the Pokémon may cause paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 身上带有静电，有时会让接触到的对手麻痹。

desc_en: Raises Speed each time the Pokémon flinches.
desc_zh_game: 每次畏缩时，不屈之心就会燃起，速度也会提高。

desc_en: Powers up Steel-type moves.
desc_zh_game: 钢属性的招式威力会提高。

desc_en: The stench may cause the target to flinch.
desc_zh_game: 在攻击的时候，有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: Protects the Pokémon from item theft.
desc_zh_game: 道具是粘在黏性身体上的，所以不会被对手夺走。

desc_en: Draws in all Water-type moves to up Sp. Attack.
desc_zh_game: 将水属性的招式引到自己身上，提高特攻。

desc_en: Boosts the power of biting moves.
desc_zh_game: 因为颚部强壮，啃咬类招式的威力会提高。

desc_en: It cannot be knocked out with one hit.
desc_zh_game: 不会被一击打倒。一击必杀的招式也没有效果。

desc_en: Negates all moves that force switching out.
desc_zh_game: 让替换宝可梦的招式和道具无效。

desc_en: Heightens the critical-hit ratios of moves.
desc_zh_game: 因为拥有超幸运，攻击容易击中对手的要害。

desc_en: Doubles Speed on Electric Terrain.
desc_zh_game: 电气场地时，速度会变为2倍。

desc_en: Powers up Bug-type moves in a pinch.
desc_zh_game: HP减少的时候，虫属性的招式威力会提高。

desc_en: Prevents itself and allies from falling asleep.
desc_zh_game: 我方的宝可梦不会变为睡眠状态。

desc_en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in rain.
desc_zh_game: 下雨天气时，速度会提高。

desc_en: Passes its held item to an ally that has used theirs.
desc_zh_game: 同伴使用道具时，会把自己持有道具传递给同伴。

desc_en: Passes a burn, poison, or paralysis to the foe.
desc_zh_game: 将自己的中毒、麻痹或灼伤状态传染给对手。

desc_en: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.
desc_zh_game: 在混乱状态时，闪避率会提高。

desc_en: Contact with it lowers the attacker's Speed.
desc_zh_game: 对于用攻击接触到自己的对手，会降低其速度。

desc_en: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.
desc_zh_game: 攻击时可以将低威力招式的威力提高。

desc_en: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.
desc_zh_game: 读取我方的攻击，并闪避其招式伤害。

desc_en: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.
desc_zh_game: 可以不受对手特性的干扰，向对手使出招式。

desc_en: Ups resistance to Fire- and Ice-type moves.
desc_zh_game: 会让火属性和冰属性的招式伤害减半。

desc_en: Powers up "not very effective" moves.
desc_zh_game: 可以将效果不好的招式以通常的威力使出。

desc_en: Powers up Water-type moves in a pinch.
desc_zh_game: HP减少的时候，水属性的招式威力会提高。

desc_en: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
desc_zh_game: 接触到对手的招式威力会提高。

desc_en: Powers up physical attacks when poisoned.
desc_zh_game: 变为中毒状态时，物理招式的威力会提高。

desc_en: The Pokémon copies a foe's Ability.
desc_zh_game: 出场时，复制对手的特性，变为与之相同的特性。

desc_en: Gives priority to a healing move.
desc_zh_game: 可以率先使出回复招式。

desc_en: Pokémon can't attack on consecutive turns.
desc_zh_game: 如果使出招式，下一回合就会休息。

desc_en: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.
desc_zh_game: 可以不受对手特性的干扰，向对手使出招式。

desc_en: Ignores any stat changes in the Pokémon.
desc_zh_game: 可以无视对手能力的变化，进行攻击。

desc_en: Raises Speed if a held item is used.
desc_zh_game: 失去所持有的道具时，速度会提高。

desc_en: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.
desc_zh_game: 让对手紧张，使其无法食用树果。

desc_en: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
desc_zh_game: 自己和同伴的命中率会提高。

desc_en: Prevents the Pokémon from falling asleep.
desc_zh_game: 通过激发出干劲，不会变为睡眠状态。

desc_en: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move.
desc_zh_game: 受到电属性的招式攻击时，回复HP。

desc_en: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move.
desc_zh_game: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，回复HP。

desc_en: Weakens incoming Fire-type moves and prevents burns.
desc_zh_game: 降低与自己相对的火属性招式的威力，不会灼伤。

desc_en: Sharply ups Defense when hit by a Water-type move.
desc_zh_game: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，防御会大幅提高。

desc_en: Prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
desc_zh_game: 将水幕裹在身上，不会变为灼伤状态。

desc_en: Physical attacks lower Defense and raise Speed.
desc_zh_game: 因物理招式受到伤害，防御降低，速度大幅提高。

desc_en: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
desc_zh_game: 被白色烟雾保护着，不会被对手降低能力。

desc_en: Cowardly switches out if its HP becomes half or less.
desc_zh_game: HP变为一半时，会慌张逃走，退回同行队伍中。

desc_en: Only super-effective moves will hit.
desc_zh_game: 不可思议的力量，只有效果绝佳的招式才能击中。

desc_en: Makes status-changing moves more likely to miss.
desc_zh_game: 成为不易受到变化招式攻击的身体。

desc_en: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is halved.
desc_zh_game: HP变为一半以下时，样子会改变。
